items.text: Philadelphia QB: Joe Milton III will make his first career start over Tanner McKee (Jalen Hurts out, calf/blood clots). Schedule already lists Milton.

Philadelphia: DNP - RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), LB Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad), CB/S Michael Carter II (abdomen), CB Jonathan Jones (hamstring), WR Britain Covey (knee); limited - K Jake Elliott (ankle), OLB Jonathan Greenard, OLB Jalyx Hunt. Large cluster to recheck on the Friday final report.

New York Giants: DNP - OLB Abdul Carter (illness), RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring); limited - OT Andrew Thomas (groin), OT Jermaine Eluemunor (calf), LB Malik Harrison, CB Colton Hood, WR Charlie Jones. TE Theo Johnson full. J.J. McCarthy starts (Jaxson Dart on IR).

adjust.reason: Philadelphia has RB Saquon Barkley, WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, LB Jihaad Campbell and CB Jonathan Jones not practicing (the last four also missed Week 8), which outweighs the Giants' Abdul Carter and Cam Skattebo concerns. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
